title: Butson towers and high-rank Hadamard matrices
abstract: We construct real Hadamard matrices of thirty-four new orders and give nine new infinite families. The constructions preserve orthogonality and ensure that every final entry is 1 or -1. Explicit recipes and reproducible formal proofs establish every new order and every member of the nine families.
subject: math.CO
comments: 28 pages. Revision of 2611.01070v1: 34 new orders and nine new infinite families (previously 18 and six). Adds a separate table of 31 recovered known orders and an exact proof that the order-885924 sixth-root representative is inequivalent to the standard Paley matrix. All 34 announced orders and nine families have complete Lean existence proofs from literal finite witnesses; 143 selected axiom reports and the pinned source-only proof package are provided. The finite-field rank comparison has a separate exact executable certificate. Includes canonical Python source recipes, literal data and standalone archive replays.
